channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: KTR Slams Revanth Reddy Govt Over Farmer Deaths, Demands ₹25 Lakh Compensation
item.description: KTR criticises Revanth Reddy government over farmer deaths in Telangana, demands ₹25 lakh compensation after a farmer died at a maize procurement centre in Gadwal district.

item.title: I Am the Voice of Telangana People, Not Operated by Anyone: Kavitha
item.description: Kavitha says she is the voice of Telangana people and not operated by anyone. Telangana Jagruthi President criticises RRR project, irrigation failures, fee reimbursement delays, and announces farmers’ movement.

item.title: No DJs, No Fireworks: Rachakonda Police Tighten New Year Rules in Hyderabad
item.description: Rachakonda Police ban DJs and fireworks for New Year celebrations in Hyderabad. Commissioner Sudheer Babu announces strict security, drunk driving checks, and traffic restrictions.

item.title: Telangana Tragedy, UKG Student Dies After Pencil Pierces Throat
item.description: A six-year-old UKG student died in a tragic school accident in Khammam district after a pencil injury. Police have launched an investigation into school safety lapses.

item.title: Ten charred to death in sleeper bus-truck collision in Karnataka’s Chitradurga
item.description: At least 10 people were charred to death, and several others sustained injuries after a private sleeper bus collided with a truck in the early hours of Thursday in Karnataka’s Chitradurga district, triggering a massive fire that left the bus completely charred.

item.title: Delhi’s air quality improves slightly; several areas record ‘moderate’ AQI
item.description: Delhi’s air quality recorded a noticeable improvement on Thursday morning, a day after the Commission for Air Quality Management in Delhi-NCR and adjoining areas revoked restrictions imposed under Stage IV of the Graded Response Action Plan, citing a sustained improvement in pollution levels.

item.title: On Christmas, Andhra govt releases one year honorarium for pastors
item.description: While participating in Semi Christmas celebrations on December 22, Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu announced that funds would be released for honorarium to pastors.

item.title: Gold and silver bring cheers for investors, 2026 outlook remains strong
item.description: With equity markets facing volatility, both metals strengthened their position as preferred safe investment options, but silver clearly outshone all traditional choices.

item.title: Air India Express flight takes off as Navi Mumbai International Airport begins operations
item.description: “Following the inaugural Bengaluru service, the airline’s inaugural Delhi flight was scheduled to depart from Navi Mumbai at 14:05 hours and arrive in the national capital at 16:20 hours,” the airline said in a statement.

item.title: Bengal SIR: ECI directs 2-level checking of supporting documents of voters during hearing sessions
item.description: The Election Commission of India (ECI) has directed a two-level verification to confirm the authenticity of the supporting identity documents of voters during the hearing session on claims and objections on the draft voters’ list starting from December 27.
